paite: Huchi in David in heutu leh makai chiteng, sangte leh zate heutute toh thu akikum uhi.
heading: Kiriath-jearim A Kipan Pathian Bawm Lakna / (2 Sam 6.1-11)

paite: David in Israel kikhawmte tengteng kiang ah, "Hoih na sak ua, TOUPA i Pathian ua kipan ahihleh, mun chiteng a Israel gam tengteng nutsiat a om i unaute kiang ah thu i khak ding ua, loupa munte nei akhopite ua akiang ua siampute leh Levi mite om, huchi a i kiang a ahong kikhopkhawm theihna ding un.
Huchi in i Pathian uh bawm i lakik nawn ding uhi; Saul hun lai in i na zong kei uhi," achi hi.
Kikhawmpi tengteng in huchibang in i hih ding uh achi ua: mi tengteng mit ah huai thil dik ahi ngal a.
Huchi in David in Israel tengteng Aigupta gam luita Shihor a kipan Hamath lutna chiang pha in, Kiriath- jearim a kipan a Pathian bawm va la ding in amite akaikhawm hi.
Huchi in David, Israel tengteng toh, Baalah huai bel, Kiriath-jearim ah ahi, huai tuh Judah gam ahi a, huai a kipan a Pathian, TOUPA Cherubte tung a tupa, aminlohna om va la ding in akuantou hi.
Pathian bawm kangtalai thak in apua ua, Abinadab inn a kipan alakhia ua: huchi in Uzza leh Ahio in ahawl uhi.
Huchi in David leh Israel tengteng Pathian ma ah ahatna tengteng un late, kaihgingte, pekging gui sawm neite, khuangtate, dakkhutbette leh pengkulte toh lopna bawl in a-om uhi.
Huan Chidon buhchilna phual ahong tun un, bawngtalte akisuih man un, Uzza in bawm len ding in akhut in asawk hi.
Uzza tung ah TOUPA hehna asouta a, bawm a akhut akhoih ziak in, amah ahihlumta hi: huchi in Pathian ma ah asita hi.
TOUPA Uzza tung a apuahkhap ziak in, David alungkim kei hi: huchi in huai lai tuni tan in, Perez-uzzah achita hi.
Huai ni in David in Pathian akihta a, bangchi in Pathian bawm inn ka kitun thei dia? chi in.
Huchi in ama'n akiang a, David khopi sung ah bawm apolut kei a, Git mi Obed-edom insung ah apolut zawta hi.
Pathian bawm bel kha thum Obed-edom inkote kiang ah insung ah a-om a: huchi in TOUPA'N Obed-edom leh aneih tengteng avualzawlta hi.
